program_status: FROZEN at P1-result (2026-07-03) per KDR-009; Track 2 (Kaggle) closed, no further experiments authorized
notes: This file is the single source of truth for every result number quoted in README, SYSTEM_OVERVIEW, the case study, the dashboard, the docs site, and release artifacts (docs/implementation/portfolio_master_plan.md, standing rule 8).

oof_mcc is the project's internal leakage-safe cross-validation metric (never used as a production gate for anything in this log). public_mcc/private_mcc are Kaggle competition leaderboard metrics on Kaggle's held-out test set.

oof_status distinguishes 'honest' (label-free, valid ranking metric) from 'contaminated' (leaks label information across CV folds via a leaky feature, e.g. train-neighbor Response lookup) OOF measurements -- contaminated values must never be compared to an honest MCC (see kaggle_decisions.md, 'What must never happen').

Every value below is transcribed from, and traceable to, the Evidence/Outcome/Decision sections of docs/research/kaggle_decisions.md. The one exception is noted per-row in the P1 entry's 'notes' field.

experiments.mechanism: Reproduce the frozen dataset_h production model end-to-end via the verified submission pipeline; establishes the honest Track 2 baseline. No new features, no training, no tuning.
experiments.hypothesis_result: PASS -- reproducibility check (not hypothesis-banded); row count/positive count/Id-set/threshold all matched the pre-registered criteria exactly
experiments.notes: Public/private LB scores were originally established by the pre-Kaggle-track dataset_h production submission (docs/dataset_h_submission_run.md); K1 confirms the artifact that produced those scores is reproducible byte-for-byte from committed code.

experiments.mechanism: Record-adjacency 'magic' features: 3 sort orders (Id, station start-time, compound) x (Id/time deltas, same-neighbor flags, train-neighbor Response lookup) added to dataset_h's 16 clean features.
experiments.notes: Contaminated OOF (train-neighbor Response leaks across CV folds) -- not comparable to an honest MCC; the LB is the only valid measurement of this model. Recovers ~49% of the documented honest-to-leaky leaderboard gap.

experiments.mechanism: Ablation of K2 (position-only variant): the 18 label-free position/delta/tie-flag columns, excluding all 6 train-neighbor-Response columns. Isolates record-proximity from neighbor-label leakage.
experiments.notes: Slightly exceeds K2's full-magic score on both LB splits despite dropping all 6 label-touching columns -- record proximity alone explains the entire observable K2 gain.

experiments.mechanism: Ablation of K2 (label-only variant): only the 6 train-neighbor-Response columns (nearest train-neighbor Response, prev/next, across 3 sort orders). Isolates neighbor-label leakage from record-proximity.
experiments.notes: Falls below even the K1 honest baseline on both LB splits -- the neighbor-label columns are actively harmful in isolation, not merely unhelpful. Neighbor-label leakage retired as a research direction after this result.

experiments.mechanism: Label-free timing-cohort geometry: min/max-date group size, position, and k=2/k=3 lag features, layered additively on K3-A's 34-feature winning stack.
experiments.hypothesis_result: CONFIRMED (at the low end of the pre-registered band)
experiments.notes: K2 (0.31699) -> K3-A (0.31791) -> K4 (0.31697): a spread of 0.00094 public LB across three experiments with materially different feature engineering -- the record-order/timing family was declared saturated after this result.

experiments.mechanism: Raw-signature duplicate/identity keys (key_date, key_numeric, key_nanpat) and derived group-size/rank/chain features, label-free, layered additively on K3-A's winning stack.
experiments.notes: This model's data_fingerprint (e9df7ffff186b6fa) is reused as the fixed regression-anchor target for every subsequent wide-modeling experiment (P0 Cell A, P1 R0).

experiments.mechanism: Identity-conditioned train-neighbor Response lookup (8 label-touching columns keyed on raw-signature identity, not adjacency), layered additively on K3-A's winning stack.
experiments.notes: Contaminated OOF (identity-conditioned train-neighbor Response); LB-only measurement, best model in the program to date at time of measurement, superseded by P0. Confirms identity-conditioned label transfer as materially real where K3-B's adjacency-conditioned label transfer was not -- a distinct mechanism, not a contradiction of K3.

experiments.mechanism: Raw ~968-column numeric sensor matrix (Cell C: K5-A's 51-column honest stack + full raw numeric columns), high-capacity LightGBM (n_estimators=2500, no early stopping triggered in any fold).
experiments.notes: Largest single-experiment OOF and private-LB gain in the program (+0.05386 OOF, +0.06680 private over K5-A). Regression anchor (Cell A, 51 K5-A columns) reproduced K5-A's OOF 0.32506 exactly, data_fingerprint e9df7ffff186b6fa, before Cell C was trusted.

experiments.mechanism: Per-station date-offset/weekly-position/transit features (Family D, 57 cols) + station/line numeric mean/std aggregates (Family S/L, 108 cols) on P0's Cell C stack, plus LightGBM capacity tuning (num_leaves 63->255, min_child_samples 50->20). Winning run: R5.
experiments.notes: Best result in the program to date. data_fingerprint c602cd26810cf626 (shared across runs R2-R5, same input dataset) is recorded in the local operational log docs/agent_memory/claude_state.md (gitignored, not published); kaggle_decisions.md's P1 evidence table itself publishes only the R0 regression-anchor fingerprint (e9df7ffff186b6fa) inline, not a per-run column like P0's evidence table. Attribution: feature families alone contributed only +0.00306 OOF; relieving LightGBM capacity on top of them recovered +0.01286 OOF -- capacity tuning, not feature engineering, was the dominant lever.
